title: Open Coffee brew methods
description: Ways of brewing coffee (espresso, pour-over, V60, AeroPress, cold brew…), their typical parameters and what a coffee journal should record for each. Methods form a tree: a device-specific method such as v60 has the general method pour-over as parent. Part of Roastbook Open Coffee.

$schema.description: Canonical URL of the schema version this file follows.

range.title: Range

min.description: Lowest common value, in the unit named by the parameter (for example grams for dose_g, degrees Celsius for brew_temperature_celsius).

max.description: Highest common value, in the unit named by the parameter.

typical.description: A good starting value, in the unit named by the parameter.

range.description: A starting range. When several values are given they must be ordered: min ≤ typical ≤ max. JSON Schema cannot compare two values, so this repository checks it in its examples and data repositories check it in their data.

parameter.title: Brew parameter
parameter.description: Parameter keys shared with coffee journals such as Roastbook. brew_ratio is grams of brew water per gram of coffee (16 means 1:16); yield_ratio is grams of drink in the cup per gram of coffee (2 means a 1:2 espresso). brew_temperature_celsius is the temperature of the brew water. uses_puck_screen records whether a puck screen sat on top of the espresso puck (true or false). paper_filter_position takes a paper_filter_position value and distribution_method a distribution_method value.

grind_size.title: Grind size
grind_size.description: Descriptive grind size; extra_fine is Turkish, fine espresso, medium filter, coarse French press and cold brew.

paper_filter_position.title: Paper filter position
paper_filter_position.description: Where paper filter discs sit in an espresso basket. none: no paper filter; top: on top of the coffee, under the shower screen; bottom: under the coffee, at the basket floor; both: one disc on top and one at the bottom.

distribution_method.title: Distribution method
distribution_method.description: How ground coffee is spread evenly in the basket before tamping. wdt: stirring with fine needles (Weiss Distribution Technique); blind_shaker: grinding into a closed cup, shaking it and tipping the coffee into the basket; distribution_tool: a spinning leveller set on the basket; stockfleth_move: sweeping the coffee level with a finger while turning the portafilter.

id.description: Stable readable slug, e.g. v60, french-press. Never reused.

name.description: Common English name of the method, for example Pour-over or French press.

aliases.description: Other names in any language, e.g. Filterkaffee, drip.

parent.description: The more general method, e.g. pour-over for v60.

category.description: Family used for grouping: espresso (9-bar style pressure), filter (percolation through a filter), immersion (steep, then separate), pressure (non-espresso pressure such as AeroPress or moka pot), vacuum (siphon), boiling (cezve/ibrik), cold (cold water over hours).

description.description: Short neutral explanation in our own words.

introduced_year.description: Year the method or device was invented or first sold.

equipment_types.description: Equipment types needed, from the equipment schema's type list.

brew_ratio.description: Grams of brew water per gram of coffee, for example 16 for 1:16. Used for filter, immersion and cold brew. A journal that keeps one ratio and a basis puts the ratio here when the basis is brew water (Roastbook: ratioBasis brew_water).

yield_ratio.description: Grams of drink in the cup per gram of coffee, for example 2 for a 1:2 espresso. Used where the drink is weighed, mainly espresso. A journal that keeps one ratio and a basis puts the ratio here when the basis is the yield (Roastbook: ratioBasis target_yield).

brew_temperature_celsius.description: Temperature of the brew water, in degrees Celsius.

grind_d50_microns.description: Median particle size in micrometres, comparable across grinders.

paper_filter_position.description: Paper filter positions commonly used with this method.

distribution_method.description: Distribution methods commonly used with this method.

recorded_parameters.description: Parameters a coffee journal should offer when logging a brew with this method.

typical_drinks.description: Drinks usually made with this method, in plain lowercase English, for example espresso, cappuccino or flat white.

wikidata.description: Wikidata item id of the method, for example Q180289 for espresso.

beanconqueror.description: Beanconqueror PREPARATION_TYPES key, for app imports.

xref.description: Identifiers of the method in other datasets and apps.

filter_types.description: Filters the method can use. paper: paper filters; metal: metal mesh or perforated metal; cloth: cloth filters; none: no filter (for example cezve or cold brew in a jar).
